Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for committing AgileCloud to the first reseller cohort for our AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO). To keep the activation timeline tight we need to do a short ops handoff that covers:

- Service/account creation and entitlements mapping (who owns the AWS customer seller-of-record setup)
- Billing split and invoice routing (portal vs. marketplace vs. reseller invoice)

- May 10–11: internal handoff call (30 min)
- May 12: DocuSign for CPPO SOW & billing terms
- May 15: CPPO activation ticket submitted to AWS CPPO Ops

If that looks good I’ll loop in our billing and partner ops folks and send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
